transcript: Speaker A: kabhi aisa hua hai, samne wala english mein baat kar raha ho aur aapko jawab aata ho, phir bhi muh se kuch nikal hi na paye? mere saath hamesha aisa hota tha. papa ke dost ne shahar mein meri naukri lagva di. mujhe laga ab life badal jayegi aur sabse pehle ek hi khyal aaya, apni dost se milungi. wahi dost jiski mohalle mein sab tarif karte hain. dekho woh ladki kitni aage badh gayi, shahar mein settle ho gayi. school mein bhi woh hamesha mujhse aage rehti thi. par ab mujhe bhi bade office mein naukri mil gayi thi. pehli baar laga, ab main bhi usse kam nahi. ab hum donon barabar hain. yahi sochkar khush-khush milne gayi. cafe mein baithe, woh apni airport ki job se sidhe aayi thi, uniform mein, ekdum confident. aur jaise hi baat shuru hui, main chup ho gayi. woh itni fluent english bol rahi thi. beech mein phone par kisi colleague se baat ki: 'Yeah, I'll handle the morning shift, tell them not to worry.' main bas dekhti rah gayi. phir mujhse hanskar boli: 'So how's the new job? You must be loving the city, na?' aur main, main bas 'haan, accha hai' se aage kuch nahi bol pai. jo barabari ka ehsaas lekar main aayi thi, woh us ek table par toot gaya. ghar aakar der tak sochti rahi. naukri to mujhe bhi acchi mili thi, par naukri milna ek baat hai, aur logon ke samne confidence se english bol pana bilkul dusri. mujhe ab dar lagne laga. jab dost ke samne do line nahi bol pai to office mein itne logon ke saath kaise baat karungi? us raat maine tay kiya, yahan tak aai hoon, ab yahan bhi peeche nahi rahungi. pehle socha class join karun, par office ke saath time nahi tha aur itne logon ke samne bolne mein sharm aati thi. phir ek online course liya, par usme ghante bhar ke lambe video, sab teji se english mein bolte jate, bas grammar ke rule ratwate. aur mujhe to bolne wali english chahiye thi, rule nahi. phir ek din usi dost se baat hui. usne mujhe apne phone par ek app dikhaya: English Seekho. aur pehli baar laga, ye mere jaise logon ke liye hi bana hai. yahan spoken english ke ek sau se jyada chhote-chhote shows the. koi ghante bhar ka lecture nahi. experts hindi mein samjhate the. wahi roj wali english, office mein, logon ke saath, normal baat-cheet mein kaam aane wali. koi bhari grammar ratne ka jhanjhat nahi. aur sabse khas, ek AI coach, Disha. usse main apne kamre mein akele, bina kisi dar ke bolkar practice karti thi. galat bolti to woh turant theek kar deti. na koi hansta na koi judge karta. bas main aur mera phone. aur dheere-dheere woh english, jo dimag mein to thi par muh tak nahi aati thi, ab apne aap nikalne lagi. kuch hi hafton mein fark saaf dikhne laga. office meeting mein pehli baar maine khud bola, apni baat, english mein, bina atke. boss ne sunkar sir hilaya. chhoti si baat thi, par mere liye sabse badi. aur agli baar jab usi dost se mili, is baar main chup baithne wali nahi thi. is baar main bhi uske saath, uske jaisi, barabari se baat kar rahi thi. wahi barabari, jo pichli baar toot gayi thi, is baar maine khud kama li. aaj samajh aaya, naukri aapko ek jagah tak pahuncha sakti hai, par is jamaane mein aage wahi nikalta hai jo khul kar bol sakta hai. degree, mehnat, talent, sabke paas hai, fark bas zubaan ka hai. to apni mehnat ko english ki kami par mat rok do. english seekho, try karo, aur apni jagah is duniya mein khud banao. Install now par click karo aur abhi English Seekho app download karo. [Has it ever happened that someone speaks to you in English, you know the answer, but can't speak? It always happened to me. My father's friend got me a job in the city. I thought my life would change and first wanted to meet my friend. The one everyone praised. She was settled and always ahead of me in school. But now I also had a big office job. I felt equal. I went to meet her happily. We sat in a cafe; she came straight from her airport job, confident in uniform. As we spoke, I went silent. She spoke fluent English. She answered a call: 'Yeah, I'll handle the morning shift, tell them not to worry.' I just stared. She asked: 'So how's the new job? You must be loving the city, na?' and I couldn't say more than 'yes, it's good'. The feeling of equality shattered. At home, I realized getting a job is one thing, but speaking English confidently is another. I got scared of speaking at work. I decided to improve. I couldn't join classes due to time, and online courses only taught grammar rules. Then my friend showed me the 'English Seekho' app. It had over 100 short spoken English shows explained in Hindi, focusing on daily conversation without heavy grammar. It also featured an AI coach, Disha, to practice speaking privately without judgment. Gradually, my English improved. I spoke confidently in an office meeting. When I met my friend again, I spoke with equal confidence. I realized that while degrees and talent matter, communication is key. Don't let a lack of English hold you back. Click 'Install Now' and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: An animated story of a young woman who secures a city job but feels inferior when she cannot converse in English with her confident, fluent friend. After struggling with traditional classes and grammar-heavy courses, she discovers the 'English Seekho' app, which offers short practical lessons and an AI coach for private practice. She successfully improves her speaking skills, regains her confidence at work, and encourages viewers to download the app to overcome their language barriers.
